info.name: Crowdbotics API Documentation admin documents API
Generate technical requirements based on user stories

items.docs:
Generate technical requirements based on user stories.

Args:
    project_id: The project ID for which to generate technical requirements
    user_stories: List of user stories to generate requirements from
    user: The authenticated user
    org_id: The organization ID from the header

Returns:
    Any: The generated technical requirements

Raises:
    HTTPException: If generation fails
